record_audits.database_note: Discovery: Isolated from a Japanese soybean fermented food in the presence of bacteria that produced this peptide. It has a very narrow activity spectrum. Activity: Active against Gram+ B.cereus JCM 2152T or AHU 1358 (MIC>128 ug/ml), B. licheniformis AHU 1371 (MIC 8 ug/ml), B.megaterium AHU 1373 (MIC >128 ug/ml), B. pumilus AHU 1386 (MIC 8 ug/ml), B. subtilis 6 strains (MIC 8-16 ug/ml), E.faecalis s strains HU1 VRE (MIC>128 ug/ml), L. fermentum ATCC 9338 (MIC 64 ug/ml), L.plantarum NRIC 1067T (MIC>128 ug/ml), L.rhamnosus ATCC 7469T (MIC > 128 ug/ml), S.aureus ATCC 25923 3 strains MRSA-inactive (MIC>128 ug/ml), S. agalactiae JCM 5671T (MIC 64 ug/ml), S. mitis JCM 12971T (MIC 64 ug/ml), S. mutans JCM 5705T (MIC 64 ug/ml), S. pneumoniae ATCC 49619 and 6 strains (MIC 8-16 ug/ml), S.pyogenes JCM 5674T (MIC 128 ug/ml), S.salivarius JCM 5707T (MIC 128 ug/ml), S. sanguinis JCM 5708T (MIC 64 ug/ml), Gram- A.baumannii ATCC 19606T or SRAC2 (MIC >128 ug/ml), E.coli ATCC 25922 and 2 strains (MIC >128 ug/ml), H.infuenza ATCC 51907 (MIC >128 ug/ml), P.aeruginosa ATCC 27853 (MIC >128 ug/ml), S.marcescens SRSM2 (MIC > 128 ug/ml), fungi C.albicans SRCA1 (MIC > 128 ug/ml). Additional and conflicting activity data against foodborne pathogens can be found in ref2 (below). Antibiofilm:bacteria: Inhibited bacterial biofilm formation:E. coli (0.5 MIC or higher). Dose-dependent antioxidant effect (IC50 35-42.5%). Antimicrobial robustness: serum-sensitive; NaCl-sensitive:E. coli (200-500 mM). Structure: helix? MOA:bacteria: The bacterial peptide appears to work on bacterial membranes. In vitro toxicity: rabbit RBC (5%): <2% hemolysis at 200 ug/ml (less hemo.lytic). Cytotoxicity: RAW264.7 cells (TC50>200 ug/ml; 90% survived at 200 ug/ml). Recombinant production:yeast:Pichia pastoris: obtained for testing food preservation. Food protection: during fresh-pork refrigerated storage at 4oC, natto peptide reduced bacterial growth of Staphylococcus spp., Escherichia spp., and Pseudomonas spp. (ref2: Dong et al., 2022) Updated 7/2025
